transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have one portable ultrasound cart available for Monday morning, and both the ICU and the vascular access service have requested it. Before I finalize the assignment, I need to hear from each of you in turn per our policy: the attending physician, the vascular access nurse, the biomedical equipment coordinator, and the infection prevention practitioner. Let's start with the attending physician — please give your brief report.

transcript.text: I need to flag an urgent timing constraint: the ICU has a patient whose temporary central access must be placed with ultrasound guidance before 08:00 Monday because the current access is due to be removed then. I reviewed the treatment plan, but the timing detail hasn't yet been captured in our equipment request. This is time-critical and factors into why the ICU needs the cart Monday morning.

transcript.text: I want to share that the vascular access team's Monday cases can be moved to the fixed ultrasound machine in Procedure Room 2 from 10:00 onward, and I've confirmed that machine has the linear probe needed for those cases.
